name: PM Agent
description: Autonomous project management agent — monitors sprints, enforces SLAs, and automates standup workflows for any Jira/Slack team.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Anthropic API key for Claude agent reasoning

ATLASSIAN_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL.description: Atlassian service account email (bot account) for API access

ATLASSIAN_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN.description: Atlassian API token for the service account

ATLASSIAN_CLOUD_ID.description: Atlassian Cloud ID — found in your Atlassian admin URL

ATLASSIAN_PROJECT_KEY.description: Jira project key to monitor (e.g. PROJ)

SERVICE_ACCOUNT_NAME.description: Bot username for mention detection (e.g. pm-bot, remington)

SLACK_BOT_TOKEN.description: Slack bot token (xoxb-...) for posting messages and reading mentions

SLACK_BOT_USER_ID.description: Slack bot user ID (Uxxx) for self-identification and mention detection

SLACK_CHANNEL_STANDUP.description: Slack channel ID for standup reports and SLA alerts

SLACK_CHANNEL_QA_ALERTS.description: Slack channel ID for QA-specific SLA alerts (falls back to SLACK_CHANNEL_STANDUP if not set)

SLACK_PM_AGENT_LOG_CHANNEL.description: Slack channel ID for internal PM agent logs and errors

BITBUCKET_WORKSPACE.description: Bitbucket workspace slug to monitor for PR mentions

BITBUCKET_REPOS.description: Comma-separated list of Bitbucket repos to monitor (e.g. repo1,repo2)

DRY_RUN.description: Set to true to log actions without posting to Slack/Jira (for testing)

scripts.postdeploy: echo 'Deployment complete. Config vars set. Run: heroku run python run_agent.py sla-check'
